purpose: Two fresh development calibration tasks for the memory spike; no memory treatment or policy search.
selection: Two short public instructions spanning repository repair and deterministic file generation. Selected before execution; original independent graders remain opaque.

evaluation.developmentUse: Tune controller policy using development tasks only.
evaluation.holdoutUse: Freeze policy first; execute each arm in fresh containers with fresh task memory. Keep holdout verifier results out of policy search.
evaluation.grading: Harbor's original task verifier runs after the agent returns. Controller completion and replay verification are not benchmark success.
evaluation.agentInput: instruction.md and the initialized task environment only; no solution, hidden verifier, or host metadata descriptions.
evaluation.costReporting: Unreported token counts and subscription-attributable costs stay null. Zero incremental paid API spend is not a zero-cost claim.

provenance.imageInspection: Docker Registry v2 manifests/config metadata only; no layers pulled during selection. Digests are observed immutable identities for the tag references; expanded disk and build peaks remain unmeasured.
